Barton County Collector-Treasurer
Collector-Treasurer Brittanica Born
We are honored to serve people of Barton County. I currently serve as your County Collector-Treasurer. My deputies are Kim Rea, Dean Sullivan, and Koleton Mahurin. This site makes information available to public. Please call or email our office with questions.
Collector-Treasurer's Office
1004 Gulf Street RM 101, Lamar, Missouri 64759, United States
417-682-5881
Hours

Barton County tax bills are normally mailed out by mid-November every year. If you do not receive a tax bill from Barton County by November 30th, please call (417) 682-5881. Missouri statutes mandate payment by December 31st whether a taxpayer receives a bill or not. Bills do occasionally get lost in the mail, but you still have an obligation to pay. Bills are currently available online 24 hours a day.
Click here to View Tax bills Online
Pay County Taxes Online here
Frequently Asked Questions
Please reach us at colltreas@countyofbarton.gov if you cannot find an answer to your question.
Can I get copy of tax receipt? Yes, you may. (Now available online) Or you can by pick up in office or have it mailed out for $1 per year printed or by email..
What is needed to obtain a Barton County Merchant License? Bring a copy of your Missouri Retail Sales License, fill out our application and cash, check or credit card to pay the $25 yearly fee or apply online above.
When is Barton County Tax Sale? On 4th Monday of every August at 10 am in 1st floor center hallway. Brochures available in office and tax sales lists available as of August 1st of each year.
